regions.name: wall-monitor
regions._t141: Column 8 (CRT TV), the first 'glow-on' state (of 4 rows: off/glow/off/glow), floating cleanly on magenta — no touching-object crop compromise needed here, unlike the desk sheet's crt-monitor. Picked to register the same cool blue-white glow as the desk CRT monitor, per the goal's 'monitor glow' light register.

_comment: Sheet path is relative to projects/bureau/references/office/ in the brain (GET /api/knowledge?file=projects/bureau/references/office/<sheet>&raw=1) — download it there first, the reference sheets are not committed to git. Re-run: python3 hub/tools/rectify.py <this-file> --out-dir /tmp/check (after adjusting 'sheet' to your local download path) and diff the sha256 in ../reports/report-lighting.json against this set's own sprite hashes.
